digest.overview: Meta dropped Muse Glimmer 30B (open weights, Apache 2.0) optimized for local agentic/coding workflows plus Muse Spark 1.2, triggering immediate llama.cpp support and GGUF ports. Open local models and agent tooling dominated discussion; frontier API updates and niche research papers filled the rest of a busy window.

top_story.headline: Meta releases Muse Glimmer 30B open weights for local agents
top_story.summary: 30B dense multimodal model (text+image) built for always-on local agent workflows under Apache 2.0. Includes day-0 llama.cpp support and Unsloth GGUF quants; positioned as biggest open release since Llama series.
top_story.why_it_matters: Directly targets local coding/agent use cases with permissive license; 367-point HN thread and rapid community ports signal strong demand for runnable open agent models.

sentiment.label: bullish
sentiment.summary: Community excited by Meta's open-weight agent model drop and immediate tooling support; optimism around runnable local alternatives to closed frontier systems.

model_releases.headline: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B and Muse Spark 1.2 open-sourced
model_releases.summary: 30B model for local agent workflows + Spark 1.2 foundation model released with weights; rapid GGUF and llama.cpp integration.

model_releases.headline: Motif-Technologies releases Motif-3
model_releases.summary: South Korea AI Foundation Model project entrant drops Motif-3; competes with Upstage Solar, LG EXAONE, SKT A.X series.

frontier_labs.headline: OpenAI: GPT-5.6 Sol powers finance workflows
frontier_labs.summary: Model ML case study shows GPT-5.6 Sol handling research-to-editable PPT/Excel pipelines for finance tasks.

research_radar.headline: ADIAS: Automated Design of Interactive Agentic Systems
research_radar.summary: Iterative candidate revision + feedback summarization for agent harness improvement.

research_radar.headline: EntropyMoE: Entropy-Aware Sparse Expert Routing for Tokenizer-Free LLMs
research_radar.summary: Byte-patch MoE architecture with dynamic routing for competitive tokenizer-free performance.

post_ideas.hook: Meta just open-sourced a 30B agent model that runs locally
post_ideas.draft: Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B ships today under Apache 2.0 with day-0 llama.cpp support. First real open-weight play aimed squarely at always-on local agents and coding workflows.
post_ideas.why_viral: Surprise open release from Meta + immediate tooling traction creates FOMO and discussion

post_ideas.hook: Local 1M context on a single 3090 just happened
post_ideas.draft: Someone loaded a 17 GB model and pulled 7 needles from a ~1M token context on one RTX 3090. Local long-context is no longer theoretical.
post_ideas.why_viral: Concrete hardware + impressive result taps into LocalLLaMA obsession with runnable scale

post_ideas.hook: Docker just shipped disposable sandboxes built for AI agents
post_ideas.draft: Docker Sandboxes: isolated, throwaway environments explicitly for running agent code. The infra layer for safe agent deployment is arriving fast.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct response to agent safety/reliability pain points; strong engineering audience
